data.narrative:
Kinetic Automation is a Series B robotics and manufacturing automation company that has raised approximately $31M to date. The valuation analysis draws from a comparable set of 9 private robotics firms across Series B and Series C stages, supplemented by 1 public market reference point.

The peer-median method anchors the analysis. Four directly comparable companies—Bedrock Robotics ($1.8B Series B), Dexterity ($1.6B Series B), Hadrian ($1.6B Series C), and Nimble Robotics ($1.0B Series C)—yield a median valuation of $1.6B, with a range spanning $1.0B to $1.8B. This peer cohort reflects same-sector positioning and matching or adjacent funding stage. No alternative valuation methods were applicable given available data constraints. The single quantitative method therefore defines the triangulation output.

The analysis supports a valuation range of $1.4B (low) to $1.9B (high), centered at $1.6B median. This implies a post-money valuation approximately 52x total capital raised. Key uncertainties include the representativeness of the four-company peer set, stage-specific adjustments between Series B and Series C comparables, and the limited depth of public market data. The single-method approach introduces dependency risk; additional revenue multiple or DCF analysis would strengthen conviction but cannot be derived from provided data.
